exit_codes.note: Exit status 0 observed; it carries no information. lemely.app.cli.main() calls cli.main(args=argv, standalone_mode=False, ...) and then returns 0 (lemely/app/cli.py:1485-1486). In non-standalone mode Click 8.4.2 returns the Exit(1) raised after 'Targets missed' (cli.py:1363) as a value instead of raising it, and main() discards that value, so the CLI process itself exits 0; the 'except click.exceptions.Exit' at cli.py:1490 is unreachable for it. Reproduced without an API call by registering a command on lemely.app.cli.cli that raises click.exceptions.Exit(1): cli.main(standalone_mode=False) returns 1 and lemely.app.cli.main([...]) returns 0 (whole-branch review B, I1). The shell and tee are not the cause. cli.py is outside this branch's file set; the fix is a follow-up issue.

spend.caveat: The ledger is the spend: it comes from the lemely/io/gemini.py pricing table at GA rates and bills thinking tokens as output tokens (M0.2/#26 landed before this branch), with gemini-3.8-flash at the promotional rate through 2026-12-31. The after run and the in-process replay were launched WITHOUT the API key, so a miss could not have gone live.
